profile_text.body:
Boston Dynamics describes itself as a leading global robotics company that builds practical robotics to tackle automation challenges and change what robots can do. Its website highlights Stretch for case handling and warehouse automation, describing the robot as easy to deploy and flexible.

The company was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts, United States. It is a for-profit public company. The company has 191 Massachusetts law exposure entries.
